notes: v520 — an honest lock screen. The tester-password screen used to say “that password didn’t work” for EVERY rejection — including when the server’s burglar-guard had paused the connection after too many tries, during which it doesn’t check passwords at all. A correct password could look wrong. The screen now tells you which it is: ⏳ paused (wait up to 15 minutes, or switch between Wi‑Fi and mobile data, then try once) versus a genuinely wrong password (check capitals and a hidden space at the end). Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
